# Parks dedication mechanism repair — held proposal

MERGED: this proposal is not merged. #1273 remains HOLD at 600a121e6585faba01694aa9ba91c547e96a3c3b. This document changes no production file.

WHAT EMERGED: HARDWIRED — the held parksAnnualPerResident draws a spending level. HARDWIRED — current monthly settlement calculates a budget balance; its own contract distinguishes that budget from the public account's cash. DECIDED — no new parks appropriation, tax dedication, recipient or payment has been produced or observed by this proposal.

VITAL STATISTICS: zero new executed tests, zero repaired runtime outcomes, zero complete five-part laws certified by this packet.

## 1. Why-chain

The law dedicates money because its operative terms identify a revenue source and share, or authorize a particular appropriation. An amount exists only because that government's actual base exists. A named share binds collections actually paid; an appropriation authorizes expenditure but does not prove payment. A parks cost reaches the budget only through the payment or other authorized accounting obligation the game actually records. Terminal: the legal dedication/appropriation and saved monetary transaction, not a sampled expenditure level.

Missing links include a filed parks share/source binding, restricted-fund accounting if the dedication creates an earmark, authorized parks program administration, and actual payments. Repeal may release an earmark; it does not automatically reverse expenditures already made.

## 2. Research

The prior Missouri and Minnesota observed dedication yields ($53.9 million / 6,208,038 residents and $56.6 million / 5,753,048 residents) are calibration observations with different tax designs and fiscal/population years. They do not supply a universal statutory appropriation or a sampled amount. No new coefficient, tax base, share, numeric bound or spending amount is proposed.

Inspected production source: main 1c500321e1d7ed5a855e7794880e31f1d380de8c. month.ts blob 5c8eca583eb2e8338e1c399b4bfde29a194b0bd7. PublicFundingMandate carries measureId, jurisdictionId, provisionIds, amount, dates, programKey and optional appropriationId. ResourceTransferOutcome carries actual transferredAmount, attemptedAmount, period, date, resourceFlowId and completed/partial/missed/blocked status.

## 3. Revisions

Remove the drawn per-resident level and its use in parksBudgetChange and parksLawAddedPct. Preserve stamps and provenance on actual consequences. Missing terms remain an explicit limit; no replacement fixed mean, invented share or assumption that every yes/no law sets money.

Budget balance is not public-account cash. Earlier five-state budget receipts established settled expense/balance movements, not independently verified money transfers from that account. Do not label those receipts paid parks cash.

## 4. What gets built, in numbered parts

1. Bind the canonical operative law and the exact provision/lineage to its filed named source and dedication/share, or its existing appropriation mandate. Coordinator owns shared parameter declarations and schema decisions. Parameter names and units must match the real writer; none are invented here.
2. Supply actual collection receipts for the named government/source/month, with tax-policy/assessment, flow and transfer outcome IDs. Use transferredAmount for positive completed or partial transfers. No attempted amount; no annual adopted revenue forecast presented as collected cash. Existing MonthFlows.levies aggregates receipts but drops individual IDs and currently excludes partial outcomes at the inspected head. Do not modify Team 3's released outgoing paid-leave hunk to repair this.
3. Dedication equals filed share times matched actual collections. It earmarks existing revenue rather than creates revenue. Restricted balance and actual expenditure must be distinct. Reject mismatched government/source/date and missing terms.
4. Use the existing appropriation/public-payment machinery for authorized payments. Cost equals positive actual payments with the correct parks program and law attribution. Preserve public-account capacity checks; no new payment guessed from dedication yield.
5. Save stamped provenance on the actual earmark or paid consequence. Monthly cost attribution reports actual expense once; avoid adding both a helper cost and the existing payments array for the same transaction.
6. Repeal ends future dedication subject to the operative legal terms. Prior earmarked balances and commitments follow their recorded legal disposition; do not presume a negative parks cost from population.
7. parksLawAddedPct must read a recorded actual change and an appropriate actual baseline, or report its unavailable mechanism. A reconstructed per-resident draw is not an access producer.

## 5. Simulated, records, world pieces, checks

Available: canonical law hierarchy; legislative draft lineage; PublicFundingMandate; resource flows and actual transfer outcomes; government budget months. Missing or unverified: usable parks share/source producer, earmarked fund record and its exact legal disposal on repeal, and complete parks payout provenance at the repaired head.

Files: Team 5 parks amount helper and parks-specific month call only. Team 3 exclusively owns paid-leave MonthFlows map/filter/append and optional saved-row stamp field. Team 8 age and Team 4 cannabis arrays must survive. Curriculum monthly append remains a separately declared overlap, not permission to edit the row now.

## 6. Proof run

NOT RUN — executor failed. Required acceptance: actual filed dedication and named-source receipts in three places sampled from all 56; positive partial and completed collections; zero collection versus missing terms; no wrong-source/government attribution; actual authorized partial/full parks payments; serialized stamps and payment IDs; duplicate settlement; repeal without automatic reversal; accounting identity and no duplicate cost. Include named actual people/businesses behind represented collections and actual recipients. Research checks compare appropriate aggregate yields, not select an actor's outcome.

## 7. Worked example

Given a governing law's recorded source, share and matching saved receipts, compute their product symbolically; no sample amount is supplied. Save the earmark with law and receipt IDs. If an authorized parks payment occurs, its actual transferredAmount becomes spending and its recorded cash movement remains the payment system's responsibility. Without that payment, dedication is not evidence of expense. Capacity or budget constraints emerge from actual records; no authored saturation curve is added.
